mfaid.description: ID of the MFA method. Read-only. Required for update operations.

type.description: Type of the MFA method. Possible values: 1 - TOTP (Time-based One-Time Passwords); 2 - Duo Universal Prompt.

name.description: Unique name of the MFA method.

hash_function.description: Type of the hash function for generating TOTP codes. Possible values: 1 - SHA-1; 2 - SHA-256; 3 - SHA-512. Required if type is set to "TOTP".

code_length.description: Verification code length. Possible values: 6 - 6-digit long; 8 - 8-digit long. Required if type is set to "TOTP".

api_hostname.description: API hostname provided by the Duo authentication service. Required if type is set to "Duo Universal Prompt".

clientid.description: Client ID provided by the Duo authentication service. Required if type is set to "Duo Universal Prompt".

client_secret.description: Client secret provided by the Duo authentication service. Write-only. Required if type is set to "Duo Universal Prompt".
